title: Map Counter
line: Folded paper waits beneath the round i sign.
shut: Shutter down. The maps are behind it for now.

town.name: Banana Town
town.line: Brick square, fountain, clock tower, and shops on cobbles.

park.name: Park
park.line: Paths circle lawns, pond, garden beds, and the mushroom shop.

bay.name: Banana Bay
bay.line: Pier and beach beside a boardwalk, volleyball court, and wrecked bar.

homestead.name: Homestead
homestead.line: A fenced roadside plot with a gate, mailbox, and whatever stands there.

rave.name: PEEL THE NIGHT
lines: Bass, beams, and a floor full of dancing bananas.
Wearable gear and coins are in the mix.
rave.door: At Banana Rave, all bananas welcome.
